subject: Important Update: Company Meeting Rescheduled
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to inform you that the company meeting scheduled for this Friday has been rescheduled to next Monday at 10:00 AM in the conference room. Please make sure to update your calendars accordingly. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to me. Thank you for your understanding. Best regards, [Your Name]
